column3: “You will know” renders the present γινώσκετε.
BSB follows the critical text with “does not confess Jesus”; the Textus Receptus adds “Christ has come in the flesh.” BSB adds “spirit” before “of the antichrist.”
“From the world’s perspective” renders “from the world.”
“Does not know” renders the aorist ἔγνω (“did not know”).
“In this world we are just like Him” recasts “even as He is, so also are we in this world.”
BSB follows the critical text with “We love” and no object; the Textus Receptus has “Him.”
BSB follows the critical text with “cannot love God” (the Textus Receptus asks “how can he love God”).
